reason: Conversation 1 repeated a canned non-answer twice, asked nothing, and ignored the homeowner's direct fire-safety worry, pushing them toward an unnecessary engineer visit. Conversation 2 asked exactly the right discriminating questions (hob type, fan whirr vs ticking), correctly identified the normal cooling-fan run-on, honestly reassured on fire risk given no smell or codes, recommended no part, and gave sensible escalation criteria (fan never stops, smell, or error). Minor quibbles with 2 are the slightly long '10-20 minutes' estimate and not explaining the 'H' indicator, but it matches the hidden truth and served the homeowner far better.
